projects.title: SECE Research Analytics
projects.subtitle: Research output, citation impact and collaboration of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki
projects.description: Unofficial bibliometric analysis of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (SECE), Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Greece: research output, citation impact, publication venues, research topics, collaboration, global reach, funding and open access, based on Scopus data.

pages.title: Research output
pages.description: Annual publication counts, growth, document types, journal and conference shares, team sizes and fractional counts of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, in Scopus since 1981.

pages.title: Citation impact
pages.description: Citation impact of the publications of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, in Scopus: totals, h-index, concentration, the most-cited papers and normalised impact by paper characteristics.

pages.title: Venues & publishers
pages.description: Where the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering of the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki publishes – publisher groups over time, the most-used journals and conference series, citation impact by venue and the diversity of venues, from Scopus data since 1981.

pages.title: Research topics
pages.description: Research topics of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, read from the titles of its Scopus publications: frequent terms, a topic model with topic trends and citation impact, rising and declining terms, and selected technologies over time.

pages.title: Collaboration
pages.description: Single-institution, national and international co-authorship of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering of AUTH, its partner institutions and their sectors, industry links, Greek partners and the breadth of its partner network.

pages.title: Global reach
pages.description: The countries, world regions and institutions abroad that appear in the affiliations of SECE papers, and how this mix has changed since the 1990s.

pages.title: Funding & open access
pages.description: Funding acknowledgements, the most frequent funders and funder groups, EU funding and open access of the publications of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, in Scopus.

pages.title: Research community
pages.description: How many Scopus author profiles publish with an SECE affiliation, how the community renews and how long newcomers stay, how concentrated output is and how often SECE researchers lead the papers they co-author (aggregate statistics only).

pages.title: Methodology & data
pages.description: How the SECE Research Analytics site was built: Scopus and ROR data, the processing pipeline, affiliation matching and its validation, definitions, data quality and limitations.
